features.text: PDAC APPROVED L4396: Therapeutic AFO providing static positioning and progressive mobility support.
PROGRESSIVE EXTENSION STRETCH: Offers gradual dorsiflexion correction for plantar flexion contractures.

STABLE, REHAB-READY FRAME: Enables safe, assisted standing or walking during therapy sessions.
THERAPEUTIC ALIGNMENT: Supports proper foot and ankle positioning for improved recovery outcomes.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
